claims.subject: urza
claims.summary: Urza and Mishra are brothers; Tawnos tells Kayla that Urza's brother was turned and fused with a machine.
claims.limitation: Birth order and childhood (Tocasia, Koilos) are not covered by the sources fetched for this pack.

claims.subject: kayla_bin_kroog
claims.summary: Kayla bin-Kroog, princess of Kroog, is Urza's wife and rules Penregon after the war.

claims.subject: harbin
claims.summary: Harbin is Kayla's son by Urza; he served as a pilot and officer and did not return from the war.
claims.limitation: His death is reported through Kayla's dialogue; its circumstances are not narrated here.

claims.subject: tawnos
claims.summary: Tawnos is Urza's former assistant and an artificer who returns to Penregon in 69 AR.

claims.subject: ashnod
claims.summary: Ashnod was an artificer who worked for Mishra during the war; Tawnos names transmogrants as her work.
claims.limitation: Kayla also calls Ashnod Mishra's torturer of Tawnos and, by rumor, his lover; the rumor is not graded as fact.

claims.subject: mishra
claims.summary: Mishra was corrupted by the Phyrexians (cards: Mishra, Claimed by Gix; Mishra, Lost to Phyrexia); Tawnos says he was turned by 'that creature' and fused with a machine.
claims.limitation: The design article and dialogue do not narrate the full mechanism of corruption.

claims.subject: urza
claims.summary: Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex on Argoth and ended the war.

claims.subject: sylex_blast
claims.summary: The Last Battle took place on Argoth, an island shattered and buried by the sylex blast; by 69 AR it is reduced to basalt spires.

claims.subject: urza
claims.summary: Teferi witnesses a spark coalescing where Urza's body burned away inside the detonation; Urza becomes a Planeswalker.

claims.subject: mightstone_and_weakstone
claims.summary: When Urza became a Planeswalker, the Mightstone and Weakstone became his eyes.
claims.limitation: Stated in an official design article describing card art and story.

claims.subject: sylex_blast
claims.summary: Episode 5 places the Shard of Twelve Worlds and the Ice Age after the detonation, and ends with the Ice Age upon Dominaria.
claims.limitation: Sequence only; the physical causal chain is not explained in the fetched text.

claims.subject: golgothian_sylex
claims.summary: Episode 5 deliberately gives incompatible origins for the sylex: found or made by Feldon, carved by Ashnod, pulled from Old Phyrexia by Gix, a giant's tooth, Tal's tear, and more.
claims.limitation: Official text frames these as competing legends; no single origin is canon in this source.

claims.subject: urza
claims.summary: Urza's obsession with Dominaria's history led to a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and Phyrexia.

claims.subject: urza
claims.summary: As a young man Urza was obsessed with the history of Dominaria and the Thran Empire that once ruled the plane.
claims.limitation: Yawgmoth's own Thran-era origin is not stated in the fetched official sources.

claims.subject: urza
claims.summary: After countless years of conflict, Urza and Yawgmoth perished together.
claims.limitation: The profile does not name the event; novel-era detail (Invasion/Apocalypse) is not ingested.

claims.subject: teferi
claims.summary: Teferi's spirit is sent back in time to witness how the sylex works firsthand.

claims.subject: ajani
claims.summary: Karn unearths the Golgothian Sylex; Ajani, revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent, destroys it.

claims.subject: saheeli
claims.summary: Saheeli crafts a replica of the sylex whose workings are unknown.
